# uniform null: n genes (the list's in-universe size) drawn without replacement from the unit's universe; DE-prior null: each gene included independently with the h3/recurrence probability (weight n_de_total + 1, median for genes missing from the prior, capped at 1, sum = n); exp_* = analytic expectation, sim_mean = simulated mean, lo95/hi95 = 2.5/97.5 percentiles of the simulation, P_ge_obs = (1 + #sim >= observed)/(NPERM + 1)
# universe: the unit's own tested universe (universes.json gene set) where it has one; FALLBACK units use the union of the tested sets of the 72 non-empty base-80 lists (34365 genes)
